verdict.rationale: Jev's docs describe only its own Choice/Score/Noul question primitives and batching/fan-out of these questions — there is no documentation of typed tool/function definitions, tool schemas, or an agent loop where the model itself invokes external tools in parallel/multi-step fashion. The closest analog (fan-out of questions in one call) is structured classification batching, not function/tool calling, so the specific capability asked for is undocumented.
